text:
Which statement about the reactivity of metals is correct?
A
Iron is more reactive than magnesium.
B
Copper reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid.
C
Potassium reacts with cold water.
D
Calcium oxide is reduced more easily than iron oxide.

options.label: A
options.text: Iron is more reactive than magnesium.

options.label: B
options.text: Copper reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid.

options.label: D
options.text: Calcium oxide is reduced more easily than iron oxide.
